title: Bonds, explained: why prices fall when yields rise
short: Bonds: why prices fall when yields rise
dek: The see-saw at the heart of finance, worked out with one ₹1,000 bond. Once this clicks, rate hikes, debt funds and FPI selling all make more sense.
card: One ₹1,000 bond, worked through at five interest rates. The see-saw that moves debt funds and stock markets.
sources: Business Standard: FPIs pull out ₹44,166 cr in October 2026
